title: Eleven Organisations and One Family
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：member　|　正文 385 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 member 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: Membership, she used to say, is a debt you agree to. My grandmother belonged to eleven organisations and one family, and the family was the one she was worst at. She was a ① member of the allotment society, the choral society, the history society, the ② member for our ward on the parish council, and, for four unlikely years, of a club for people who kept bees. Every ③ member of the family, meanwhile, learned to telephone her rather than the other way round.

The ④ member who mattered most, in her own account, was not a person at all: it was the society's minute book, which she kept for nineteen years and which recorded, in eleven volumes, who had promised what. Minutes, she said, are how a group of ⑤ members becomes a group of people who cannot pretend. I was eleven before I understood that this was not boring.

She was also, by a margin nobody has ever measured, the least reliable member of her own household. She forgot two birthdays a year, every year, and remembered every subscription; and in wet weather every ⑥ member ached, which she reported as news. My mother, who was a ⑦ member of staff at the primary school for thirty-one years and a member of nothing else at all, found this funny, and I have never been able to decide whether that was generosity or something else.

In 1998 the ⑧ members of the history society voted to name a bench after her. It is still there, by the church, with one ⑨ member of it replaced in 2011 after it rotted, and a member of the family sitting on it roughly once a decade. She died in 2001, having outlived four of her eleven organisations, all of which folded within two years of her leaving them. That is not a coincidence and it is not quite an achievement either.

I have her minute books. Every member, in her book, owed the others a minute. What they show is not efficiency. They show a woman who understood that a ⑩ member is not somebody who attends; a member is somebody who can be asked, in public, what they said they would do. Our family never learned to do that to each other, which is why the family was the one thing she was bad at.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 成员；一分子（a member of）
B. n. 会员（俱乐部、社团的会员）
C. n. 议员；委员（民选或被任命的代表）
D. n. （团体的）组成者；构成单位（拟人化的成员）
E. n. 构件；部件（工程、结构）
F. n. 肢体；身体的一部分（旧义／解剖）
G. 固定搭配：member of the family 家庭成员
H. 固定搭配：member of staff 员工；职员

items.q: She was a member of the allotment society
the member for our ward on the parish council
The member who mattered most, in her own account, was not a person at all
how a group of members becomes a group of people
in wet weather every member ached
a member of staff at the primary school
the members of the history society voted to name a bench
one member of it replaced in 2011
a member is not somebody who attends

answers.why: 指社团的“会员”，说她同时是园艺会、合唱团、历史学会的会员。
the member for ... 指教区议会中代表本选区的“议员、委员”。
member of the family 意为“家庭成员”，说家里每个人都学会主动打电话给她。
此处 member 拟人化，指“构成者、成员”，说最重要的成员不是人而是会议记录本。
指一群“成员、分子”，说会议记录能让一群会员变成无法抵赖的一群人。
member 指“肢体、身体部位”，说阴雨天她每个关节都酸痛，还把这当新闻讲。
member of staff 意为“员工、职员”，说母亲在小学当了三十一年职工。
指历史学会的“会员们”，说他们投票以她的名字命名一张长椅。
member 指“构件、部件”，说长椅有一根构件在2011年朽坏后被换掉。
泛指“成员”，说成员不是来开会的人，而是能被当众追问承诺的人。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 她是园艺会和合唱团的会员。（member of）
她是我们选区在教区议会的议员。（the member for）
与此同时，家里每个成员都学会了主动给她打电话。（member of the family）
会议记录能让一群会员变成无法抵赖的一群人。（members）
她什么会都没入，却把这个家维持了三十一年。（a member of nothing）
历史学会的会员们投票以她的名字命名一张长椅。（members of）
answers: She was a member of the allotment society and the choral society.
She was the member for our ward on the parish council.
Every member of the family learned to telephone her instead.
Minutes are how a group of members becomes a group who cannot pretend.
She was a member of nothing at all and kept the house going for thirty-one years.
The members of the history society voted to name a bench after her.
